# AnswerCue 2.8.0

This release refreshes the main interview workspace and adds the new OpenAI and Anthropic models. The floating live interview shell keeps its existing appearance.

## Workspace and Chat

- Cleaner light and dark themes, neutral backgrounds, consistent spacing, and restrained AnswerCue accents.
- Collapsible interview list and interview settings panels. Smaller windows use side drawers while large windows retain a comfortable reading width.
- Search saved interviews by title or summary without leaving the conversation.
- A growing multiline composer, useful preparation starters, clearer message authors and timestamps, and copy-response controls.
- Attach reusable documents without repeating their classification. Document-only messages can be sent, attachments clear from the composer after sending, and their context stays with the conversation.
- Improved syntax-highlighted code blocks, inline code, and Markdown tables in saved and follow-up conversations.
- Reading earlier messages no longer forces the chat to scroll down on each update; a jump-to-latest control returns to the newest response.

## Models and Audio Controls

- New OpenAI options: GPT 6 Astra, GPT 6.1 Sol, GPT 6 Luna, and GPT 5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna.
- New Anthropic options: Claude Opus 5 and 5.5, and Claude Sonnet 5 and 5.5.
- Shared model metadata keeps model names, reasoning settings, output limits, and first-token budgets consistent across request paths.
- Screenshot generation tries the selected chat model before provider fallbacks instead of silently preferring another model.
- Search the workspace model selector by model or provider name.
- Compact, keyboard-accessible microphone and meeting-audio selectors retain the existing audio-device selection behavior.

## Settings and Accessibility

- Refined Settings layout with compact navigation on small windows.
- Keyboard-operable switches, dialog focus handling, and Escape-to-close behavior.
- Escape closes an open model/document menu without also closing the panel behind it.
- Fixed duplicate React keys in Settings animations.
- Floating Help no longer covers Send when sidebars collapse; Help remains available from the top-bar question mark.

## Installers and Signing

| Platform | Download |
| --- | --- |
| Windows Intel/AMD x64 | `AnswerCue-Setup-2.8.0.exe` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `AnswerCue-2.8.0-arm64.dmg` and `AnswerCue-2.8.0-arm64-mac.zip` |
| macOS Intel | `AnswerCue-2.8.0.dmg` and `AnswerCue-2.8.0-mac.zip` |

- Windows release builds require Azure signing credentials and verify Authenticode signatures for both the application and installer before uploading assets.
- macOS release builds require Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, and stapling checks for both architectures and disk images.
- This release remains a draft until the platform builds and signature checks complete. No unsigned fallback is intended for this tagged release.
- Updater manifests (`latest.yml`, `latest-mac.yml`) and generated blockmaps accompany the installers. Updates use the AnswerCue repository, not the upstream release channel.

## Verification

- Local TypeScript check and production renderer build passed.
- Automated test suite: 1,025 passed, 41 skipped, 0 failed.
- UI checks used synthetic, local-only data for light/dark layouts, narrow and wide windows, interview navigation, document sending, model search, audio selection controls, copy feedback, scrolling, and keyboard interactions. These checks do not substitute for live audio or installed-platform testing.

## Known Limitations

- Model access and API billing depend on your provider account and credentials.
- Windows SmartScreen or organization security policy may still warn about a newly released installer even when its signature is valid.
- Microphone, screen recording, and other OS permissions remain controlled by the operating system. This UI refresh does not grant or reset them.
- This release does not include Linux, Windows ARM64, or Windows 32-bit installers.

Source: https://github.com/FarzamHejaziK/AnswerCue/compare/v2.7.18...v2.8.0
